summary: Northwest Biotherapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement registering 40.3 million shares of common stock pursuant to a $4.9 million convertible promissory note with YA II PN, Ltd., plus 9.7 million shares for warrants at $0.205. The offering is a routine shelf takedown under an existing registration statement; no special situation event is involved. The company is issuing shares over time as the note converts, with proceeds after fees of $4.655 million. This is standard capital-raising activity, not a strategic event, so it is classified as None with high confidence.
